data.action: 扣下工作手机，挖起第一勺布丁，放松肩膀。
data.description: 深夜便利店外，早坂爱穿藏蓝夹克和牛仔裤，靠在长椅上揭开布丁盖。她把工作手机扣在纸袋旁，慢慢挖起第一勺，肩膀随一口满足的叹息放松下来。
data.promptProse: Ai Hayasaka leans against the convenience-store bench, peeling the pudding lid before lifting the first spoonful with a relieved breath. Her opaque navy jacket, cream T-shirt and jeans remain ordinary and relaxed. A work phone lies face-down beside the paper bag. The medium night view includes the shopfront behind; its soft frontal light reveals her loosening shoulders and blonde ponytail, with the bench casting a low shadow across the pavement.
data.title: 早坂爱 · 下班后的最后一颗布丁
